notes.title: Global Update - Region 1, some news and plans for the future
notes.content:
Greetings to all City 13 residents! I am glad to present the first global update. The game has significantly changed since its demo version.

Below you’ll find the list of changes:

1)	Most of opponents have been changed. Added new enemies better fitting into the game atmosphere. 
2)	On the streets of City 13 you will find the evil henchmen of the Mayor - police, robots and even a tank! And the mysterious laboratory is now full of monsters and zombies!
3)	Some of the levels have been reworked, 1 new level has been added.
4)	Difficulty and balance have changed significantly. Most enemies’ and bosses’ characteristics have been changed. 
5)	Small plot dialogs have been added.

What’s next? I am currently working on character change function, adding vehicles and translating the game into some languages. 
I’ll do my best to finish the main version by the year end. 

Hope for your support,
Thank you.

notes.title: Welcome to the City 13!
notes.content: Hello to all new residents of City 13! I am pleased to inform you that access to the city has been finally opened! The game has undergone major changes compared to its beta version: added new enemies, bosses and more! The full list of changes will be released soon.[b] City 13 is already waiting for you![/b]

notes.title: City 13
notes.content:
[i]Greetings to all new residents of City 13!  My name is Alexander Negreevv, I am the founder and mayor of City 13. I really hope that you will like this beautiful place… In any case, you have nowhere else to go.[/i]

[b]Dear players![/b] I'm glad to present the City 13 demo. I tried to show the maximum amount of game content, so it resulted to be quite large-scale. This version includes 11 main and 1 additional level, 3 bosses, more than 10 types of enemies and traps, player skills, item store, and so on.

I really hope you enjoy City 13! Would be glad to hear from you any feedback and suggestions to my mail anegreevwork@gmail.com or in Steam discussions.

[b]Good luck![/b]

notes.title: Coming soon: Free demo on Steam Game Festival: Autumn Edition!
notes.content:
Greetings to all residents of City 13!

Thanks to everyone who shows attention to the game and adds it to their wishlist!

Good news! City 13 will take part in the Steam Game Festival: Autumn Edition. And any of you can try out the free demo version of the game!

[b]The planned release date of the game is October 14, 2020.[/b]
